remarks: Please submit HIGHEST and BEST offers by 3pm Tuesday March 10th.   Set in a highly sought after south Wilton,CT cul de sac, this light-filled home offers refined design and effortless indoor-outdoor living. Rebuilt in 1999 and thoughtfully renovated in 2009, the open layout feels both expansive and welcoming. From the moment you enter, front-to-back and side-to-side sightlines, soaring ceilings, and oversized windows create an airy, elegant first impression. The gracious living room features custom millwork, a striking stone fireplace, dining area, and upper dormer windows that add architectural detail and natural light. The open kitchen with recent upgrades is designed for both daily living and entertaining, showcasing high-end appliances, custom cabinetry, and a walk-in pantry. A sun-filled breakfast room with built-ins and a wall of windows overlooks the beautifully landscaped, level backyard and in-ground gunite pool, offering a seamless connection to outdoor living. Multiple gathering spaces include a cozy family room with built-ins and stone fireplace, a flex space or recreation room, and a large second-floor bonus room. The first-floor primary suite provides privacy and convenience with 2 walk-in closets and a pristine full bath. A 5th bedroom,full bath off the bonus room is perfect for guests or extended living needs. Bluestone patios, private and level backyard, lighted basketball court, room for volleyball, soccer and more.
